items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There's a guy named Robichaud, John Robichaud was a violin player. No, John Robichaud, no. A.J. P. Rohn, Peter Boccage. No, none of them.

ctx.x: Kaiser, played the clarinet, didn't he? Yeah. Oh yeah. And they had a tall fella in the band. He was a good resistance. He was a reader. I think he played violin, but I can't think of his name. Well, let's see. I don't think he was in no relation to them.
There's a guy named Robichaud, John Robichaud was a violin player. No, John Robichaud, no. A.J. P. Rohn, Peter Boccage. No, none of them.
Paul Dominguez. A brown skin fella. Paul Dominguez.
